records.title: Two-minute breathing reset
records.description: Breathe in for four counts, hold for two, and breathe out for six. Repeat five times.

records.title: 5-4-3-2-1 grounding
records.description: Name five things you see, four you feel, three you hear, two you smell, and one you taste.

records.title: One-task reset
records.description: Write the next task as one tiny action that can be started in less than five minutes.

records.title: Body check
records.description: Notice your breathing, shoulders, hands, and jaw. Relax one area at a time.

records.title: Rest plan
records.description: Choose one short, realistic recovery action before returning to responsibilities.

records.title: Reach one person
records.description: Send one honest message to someone safe or sit near supportive people.

records.title: Reach support service
records.description: Consider contacting PACC or another trusted support service for guided help.

records.title: Reach immediate support
records.description: Move near a safe person or contact emergency, campus, or trusted support immediately.
